title: Surreal Dragon Dreamscape
description: A vibrant surreal scene featuring a large orange dragon coiled into an infinity shape, ridden by a red-hooded figure holding a smiley-face staff. Below, a woman in a yellow dress walks a bright green dog on a leash through a field of colorful flowers, with black cats perched on dead trees and hot air balloons floating in a dramatic orange and purple sky.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal fantasy scene with a giant orange scaled dragon forming an infinity loop in the sky, a figure in a flowing red hooded cloak riding it and holding a staff topped with a smiley face, text and symbols dripping down the dragon's body. In the foreground a woman in a bright yellow dress walks a muscular lime green dog wearing a pink hat, through a field of oversized poppies and flowers, with dead trees holding black cats, multiple hot air balloons in the sky including one with STSS text, dramatic swirling orange and purple cloudy sunset, whimsical yet dark atmosphere.
